docs.title: Architecture
docs.text: This project is structured for a single-file output while keeping internal modules clean and future‑proof. The architecture divides responsibilities across configuration, data, UI, and app lifecycle layers.

docs.title: Directory Layout (Source)
docs.text:
project/
  src/
    app/
      boot.ts            # application bootstrap & lifecycle
      refresh.ts         # auto/manual refresh logic
      state.ts           # in-memory state

    config/
      env.ts             # .env loading & validation (Zod)
      schema.ts          # config schema definitions

    data/
      excelReader.ts     # Excel file access & sheet loading
      model.ts           # normalized row model
      transform.ts       # sorting, slicing, latest-row logic
      parsers/
        parseDate.ts     # robust Date parsing
        parseNumber.ts   # numeric normalization
        cleanText.ts     # whitespace & artifact cleanup

    ui/
      render.ts          # render orchestration
      layout.ts          # RTL layout & page shell
      styles/
        tailwind.css     # Tailwind entry point
      components/
        Header.ts        # logo + title
        StatusLine.ts    # refresh status (Jalali) + manual actions
        DataTable.ts     # history + latest highlight
        ErrorCard.ts     # error state UI

    i18n/
      fa.ts              # Persian UI strings
      formatters.ts      # Jalali date & number formatters

    utils/
      logger.ts          # lightweight logging
      guards.ts          # safety helpers

  scripts/
    pack-single-html.ts  # inline & bundle into one HTML

  tests/
    date.test.ts         # date parsing + Jalali conversion
    excel.test.ts        # Excel read + header detection
    sanitize.test.ts     # text + numeric normalization

docs.title: Runtime Flow
docs.text:
1. Bootstrap (app/boot.ts)
  2. Initializes state and kicks off data load.
  3. Excel Read (data/excelReader.ts)
  4. Loads the first worksheet.
  5. Detects columns from header row (left to right, stops at empty).
  6. Parsing & Normalization (data/parsers/*)
  7. Cleans text and normalizes numeric fields.
  8. Parses dates with fallback formats and Excel serial support.
  9. Transform (data/transform.ts)
  10. Sorts by Date descending.
  11. Slices based on ROWS_PER_PAGE.
  12. Identifies the latest row for highlight.
  13. Render (ui/render.ts)
  14. Renders header, status line, table, or error state.
  15. Refresh (app/refresh.ts)
  16. Auto-refresh interval + manual refresh button + manual file picker fallback.
  17. Auto-refresh updates data only when the Excel file mtime changes; manual refresh triggers a full page reload.
  18. On refresh failure, display a visible error once while retrying silently until recovery.

docs.title: Build Output
docs.text:
• A single static index.html is produced by bundling and inlining scripts, styles, and libraries.
  • All runtime dependencies are embedded to guarantee offline operation.

See Build & Packaging for details.

docs.title: Build & Packaging
docs.text: This project produces one file only: index.html. The output must run fully offline with all dependencies inlined and minified into a single line.

docs.title: Toolchain (Locked Versions)
docs.text:
These versions are fixed and must not be modified:

  • Dev Container: node:25
  • Node: 25.x
  • Vite: 7.3.x
  • Vitest: 4.0.16
  • Tailwind CSS: 4.1.x
  • SheetJS (xlsx): 0.18.x
  • jalaali-js: 1.2.8
  • Zod: 4.3.x
  • esbuild: 0.27.x
  • dotenv: 17.2.x
  • typescrip 5.9.x
  • tsx 4.21.x
  • types/node 25.0.x

docs.title: Build Flow
docs.text:
1. Load .env with dotenv.
  2. Validate configuration using Zod in src/config/schema.ts and fail if any extra variables beyond the required five are present.
  3. Bundle with Vite/esbuild.
  4. Inline assets via scripts/pack-single-html.ts.
  5. Emit index.html as a single, self‑contained file.

docs.title: Runtime Behavior
docs.text:
• index.html runs from disk (file://) without a server.
  • The Excel file is read from the configured path (local or network share).
  • A refresh timer updates data at AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS, using file modification time (mtime) to detect changes and re-read only when needed.

docs.title: Deployment
docs.text:
• Distribute only the final index.html.
  • Ensure the Excel file exists at EXCEL_FILE_PATH on the target machine.
  • For CI/CD, use GitHub Actions with encrypted secrets (not plaintext .env).

For configuration details, see Configuration.

docs.title: Configuration (.env)
docs.text: All UI configuration is read from a .env file and validated before building. The application will not build unless all required variables are present and non‑empty, and no extra variables beyond the required five are included.

docs.title: Required Variables
docs.text: Variable Type Description PAGE_TITLE string Visible page title in the UI (Persian). COMPANY_LOGO_ASSET_PATH string Path to the static SVG asset (checked into the repo). EXCEL_FILE_PATH string Absolute or relative path to the Excel file. ROWS_PER_PAGE number Number of rows displayed in the table. AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS bigint Auto refresh interval in milliseconds.

docs.title: Validation Rules
docs.text:
• All variables must exist and be non-empty.
  • No additional keys are allowed; the build fails on unknown .env entries.
  • ROWS_PER_PAGE and AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS must be valid integers.

docs.title: Logo Asset
docs.text: The company logo must be stored as a static SVG asset in the repository (for example, assets/company-logo.svg). Reference this file using COMPANY_LOGO_ASSET_PATH so the build can inline it at build time. This avoids embedding large SVG markup directly in .env.

docs.title: Example .env
docs.text:
PAGE_TITLE=برنامه تولید کارخانه
COMPANY_LOGO_ASSET_PATH=assets/company-logo.svg
EXCEL_FILE_PATH=\\\\server\\share\\production.xlsx
ROWS_PER_PAGE=10
AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS=1800000

docs.title: Security Notes
docs.text:
• The .env file is intended for local build-time configuration.
  • The generated index.html includes the resolved values, so treat it as production output.
  • CI should use encrypted secrets instead of committing .env to source control.

For build configuration details, see Build & Packaging.

docs.title: Data Pipeline
docs.text: This document describes how Excel data is read, validated, normalized, and presented.

docs.title: Excel Input Rules
docs.text:
• The Excel file contains exactly one worksheet.
  • Header row defines column names, read left-to-right.
  • Column detection stops at the first empty header cell.
  • Every row must contain a Date value.
  • The Date header is detected case-insensitively and in Persian/Arabic: Date, date, تاریخ, etc. (first header named Date/تاریخ).

docs.title: Row Normalization
docs.text:
1. Text cleanup
  2. Trim whitespace
  3. Remove invisible characters
  4. Number parsing
  5. Remove thousand separators and spacing artifacts
  6. Accept English, Persian, and Arabic numerals
  7. Date parsing (authoritative field)
  8. Accepts multiple string formats:
    • YYYY-MM-DD
    • DD/MM/YYYY
    • MM/DD/YYYY
  9. Accepts English, Persian, and Arabic digits and separators
  10. Handles Excel serial date values
  11. Normalizes to date-only (no time component)
  12. Any unparseable or empty Date triggers a global error state

docs.title: Sorting & Pagination
docs.text:
• Rows are sorted by parsed Date descending.
  • The newest ROWS_PER_PAGE rows are shown.
  • The latest row is visually dominant with:
  • strong background highlight
  • thick border
  • Persian badge واپَسین
  • increased font weight

docs.title: Error Handling
docs.text:
If any of the following occurs, a Persian error state is shown and the table is hidden:

  • Missing or unreadable Excel file
  • Any row with an empty or unparseable Date

See UI & Localization for display behavior details.

docs.title: Purpose
docs.text: This document defines the DevOps architecture for the ProdSight offline application. The system delivers a single, fully self-contained HTML file (index.html) that runs entirely offline via file://, includes all dependencies, and can be distributed through internal networks or removable media.

docs.title: Core Principles
docs.text:
• Single-file runtime: Only index.html is required at runtime.
  • Offline-first: No servers, no services, no runtime environment dependencies.
  • Deterministic builds: Pinned tooling and strict configuration validation.
  • Secure distribution: Checksummed output with offline verification.

docs.title: Build Model
docs.text:
The build is authoritative and build-time only. All configuration, assets, and dependencies are inlined during build and emitted as a single-line, fully minified HTML file.

Runtime deliverable: - dist/index.html (single-line, self-contained, and offline-capable)

docs.title: Configuration Management
docs.text:
Configuration is build-time only and sourced from either local .env files or CI secrets.

Allowed variables (exactly five): - PAGE_TITLE - COMPANY_LOGO_ASSET_PATH - EXCEL_FILE_PATH - ROWS_PER_PAGE - AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS

Validation rules: - All five variables must be present and valid. - Any extra variable causes the build to fail. - Values are inlined into the output at build time.

docs.title: Tooling
docs.text:
• Node.js 25.x (pinned)
  • esbuild for bundling and minification
  • HTML/CSS/JS minified to a single line
  • Third-party libraries (SheetJS + Jalali) fully inlined
  • Fonts can optionally be embedded for future-proofing

docs.title: Build Flow (Local & CI)
docs.text:
1. Load configuration from .env (local) or secrets (CI).
  2. Validate configuration (presence, types, and no extras).
  3. Bundle the application and vendor libraries.
  4. Inline configuration and assets.
  5. Aggressively minify to a single-line output.
  6. Emit dist/index.html.
  7. Generate SHA256SUMS.txt for integrity verification.

docs.title: CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
docs.text:
CI produces the same deterministic artifact as local builds and never uses .env files.

Triggers: - Manual - Commit-based - Hotfix

Outputs: - index.html - SHA256SUMS.txt

Artifacts are published to the release or exported for distribution.

docs.title: Runtime Excel Handling
docs.text:
Runtime behavior supports both automatic path loading and manual fallback.

Load strategy: 1. Auto-load using EXCEL_FILE_PATH (best-effort across OS/path formats). 2. Fallback to a manual “Select Excel file” picker.

Refresh logic: - Periodic polling based on AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS. - Change detection uses lastModified when a file handle exists, otherwise a content hash. - On failure: show a Persian error, hide the table, and continue retrying silently. - Manual refresh is disabled while a file is being read.

docs.title: Compatibility Guarantees
docs.text:
• Works in all modern browsers.
  • Runs on all major operating systems.
  • Opens via file:// without any servers.
  • Network share access is governed by OS authentication.

docs.title: Security & Integrity
docs.text:
• Builds are deterministic (pinned dependencies).
  • SHA-256 checksums are required for output verification.
  • Offline integrity verification is supported in regulated or air-gapped environments.

docs.title: Definition of Done
docs.text:
• Single output file: index.html.
  • Output is fully minified to a single line.
  • No runtime dependencies or servers.
  • Excel auto-load with manual fallback.
  • Signed or checksummed output for distribution.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text: ProdSight is a single-file offline HTML application for monitoring factory production plans and outputs stored in an Excel file. It renders a professional, Persian (پارسی), RTL interface, supports all major operating systems and browsers, and refreshes data on a schedule or via a manual refresh button.

docs.title: Goals
docs.text:
• Deliver a single static index.html file that runs fully offline.
  • Read Excel data from a local path or network share and render a sortable, paginated table.
  • Provide a formal, premium UI with clear status and error states.
  • Ensure strict configuration validation via .env at build initialization.

docs.title: Non‑Goals
docs.text:
• Server-side data fetching or hosting.
  • Multi-file deployments.
  • Online/CDN dependencies.

docs.title: Constraints
docs.text:
• All code (HTML/CSS/JS) is inlined in the single output file.
  • Output is single-line, minified index.html suitable for distribution.
  • Tool versions are locked (Tailwind, SheetJS, Vite, etc.).
  • Scheduled refresh updates data in-place using file modification time (mtime) checks; manual refresh triggers a full page reload.

docs.title: Primary User Flow
docs.text:
1. The user opens the index.html file via file:// from local disk or USB.
  2. Excel file is loaded from the configured path (often a network share).
  3. Data is parsed, normalized, and validated.
  4. UI renders a RTL Persian table with latest row emphasis.
  5. Automatic refresh runs at the configured interval.

If the configured path is unavailable or the browser blocks access, the user can manually select the Excel file via a file picker fallback. Access control is assumed to be handled by OS login and share permissions.

For technical details, see Architecture and Data Pipeline.

docs.title: ProdSight Delivery Roadmap for v0.1
docs.text: This roadmap follows the project’s offline, single-file output constraints and IaC-only DevOps requirements. Steps are ordered by dependencies and split by role. Each step includes an observable outcome.

docs.title: 1.1 Create Devcontainer (IaC)
docs.text: Outcome: Developers can open the repo in a Devcontainer with pinned Node 25.x, required tooling preinstalled, and One command bootstraps the environment (dependencies, env validation hooks, tooling).

docs.title: 2.1 Initialize project scaffold
docs.text: Outcome: A minimal build pipeline exists (Vite/esbuild setup per constraints).

docs.title: 2.2 Produce the first minimal index.html
docs.text: Outcome: Single-line, offline-capable dist/index.html is generated with a basic UI shell.

docs.title: 2.3 Add strict config validation stub
docs.text: Outcome: Build fails when required .env variables are missing or extra variables are present.

docs.title: Phase 3 — DevOps: CI/CD, Packaging, and Distribution (IaC)
3.1 Set up CI build pipeline (IaC)
docs.text: Outcome: GitHub Actions (or equivalent) builds the single-file artifact using secrets (no .env in CI).

docs.title: 3.2 Enforce deterministic, single-line output
docs.text: Outcome: Build process guarantees dist/index.html is one line and all dependencies are inlined.

docs.title: 3.3 Generate integrity checksums
docs.text: Outcome: SHA256SUMS.txt produced for index.html.

docs.title: 3.4 Publish build artifacts
docs.text: Outcome: index.html and checksum are available from CI artifacts or release page.

docs.title: 4.1 Implement Excel loading and parsing pipeline
docs.text: Outcome: Excel data is read from EXCEL_FILE_PATH, normalized, and validated.

docs.title: 4.2 Build RTL Persian UI and status components
docs.text: Outcome: UI matches the Persian RTL design with header, status line, and table rendering.

docs.title: 4.3 Implement refresh logic and error states
docs.text: Outcome: Auto-refresh and manual refresh function correctly with visible error handling.

docs.title: 4.4 Finalize configuration validation
docs.text: Outcome: Build fails on missing/extra .env variables per schema.

docs.title: 4.5 Release-ready build output
docs.text: Outcome: Production build yields only dist/index.html and checksum, fully minified.

docs.title: Testing & Quality
docs.text: Testing focuses on data correctness, parsing robustness, and stability of the offline build.

docs.title: Unit Tests
docs.text:
Location: tests/

  • date.test.ts — date parsing and Jalali conversion
  • excel.test.ts — Excel reading and header detection
  • sanitize.test.ts — text and numeric normalization

docs.title: Suggested Validation Checklist
docs.text:
• Config validation fails when any .env variable is missing.
  • Config validation fails when extra .env variables are present.
  • Date parsing accepts known formats and rejects invalid rows.
  • Pagination respects ROWS_PER_PAGE.
  • RTL layout and Persian formatting match expectations.

docs.title: Build Verification
docs.text:
• Output is a single index.html file.
  • Output is single-line minified HTML.
  • Page runs with no external dependencies.
  • Excel file is read from EXCEL_FILE_PATH.
  • CI runs in GitHub Actions using Node 25.x and encrypted secrets.

See Build & Packaging for pipeline details.

docs.title: Operations & Troubleshooting
docs.text: This guide lists common issues and recommended resolutions.

docs.title: Excel File Not Found
docs.text:
Symptoms - Persian error state displayed - No table rendered

Checks - Verify EXCEL_FILE_PATH is correct - Confirm file exists at the path on the target machine - Confirm file is not locked by another process - If the network share is temporarily unavailable, the app will continue retrying in the background and recover automatically - Use the manual “select file” fallback if the browser blocks direct access to the share

docs.title: Date Parsing Errors
docs.text:
Symptoms - Error state shown despite valid Excel path

Checks - Inspect the Date column for empty cells - Ensure consistent formats (YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY) - Remove stray invisible characters or mixed separators

docs.title: Manual Refresh Not Updating
docs.text:
Symptoms - No page reload

Checks - Ensure the environment allows page reloads

For deeper details, refer to the Architecture and UI & Localization pages.

docs.title: UI & Localization
docs.text: The UI is designed for Persian (Farsi) users with an elegant, corporate look and RTL layout.

docs.title: Language & Direction
docs.text:
• Language: Persian (پارسی)
  • Layout direction: dir="rtl"
  • Dates: Jalali (Shamsi) format, date-only (no time)
  • Numbers: Persian locale formatting (fa-IR) with support for English/Persian/Arabic digits

docs.title: Page Header
docs.text:
• Company logo from COMPANY_LOGO_ASSET_PATH (static SVG asset)
  • Title from PAGE_TITLE
  • Formal typography and spacing for readability

docs.title: Status Line
docs.text:
• Shows last refresh time in Jalali format
  • Includes a manual refresh button that is disabled while a read is in progress
  • Auto refresh operates at AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS and re-reads only when the source file mtime changes
  • Provides a manual “select file” fallback when the configured path is unavailable

docs.title: Table Behavior
docs.text:
• Responsive RTL table suitable for standard laptop resolution
  • Latest row is emphasized with highlight, thick border, and badge واپَسین
  • Unparseable or missing values show a Persian placeholder (e.g., —)

docs.title: Error State
docs.text:
On critical failures (date parsing or file access):

  • Render a clear Persian error card
  • Hide the data table completely
  • If an automatic refresh fails (e.g., network share temporarily unavailable), show the error once and keep retrying silently until recovery

See Data Pipeline for data rules and Configuration for required values.
